assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances.
A cardiac event monitoring study is performed/ordered.
The cardiac event monitoring study is evaluated for potential arrhythmias.
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded as CPT 93271.
The cardiac event monitoring study is medically necessary.
The cardiac event monitoring study directly addresses the diagnosed conditions of I25.10 and I34.0.
The patient has a diagnosis of I25.10.
The patient has a diagnosis of I34.0.
The diagnoses are documented in the clinical indication.
